title: Maze game with generated levels
when: The user wants a maze game: generated mazes that the player walks through with keys or swipes to reach the exit, growing level by level.
prompt:
Goal: Perfect mazes from a seed, crisp drawing and responsive movement with an optional path hint.
Steps:
1. logic.mjs generate(w, h, rand): iterative depth first backtracker with an explicit stack; walls as bits N=1, E=2, S=4, W=8, removed on both cells.
2. canMove(maze, cell, dir) and solve(maze, start, end) by breadth first search.
3. Draw walls on a dpr scaled canvas with half pixel offsets; player and exit as distinct shapes; canvas role="img" with an aria-label.
4. Arrows and WASD, swipes, on screen buttons; holding repeats every 120 ms.
5. Levels from 8x8 to 30x30, a seeded random so each level number gives the same maze; Hint shows the next 5 steps.
6. Timer and moves; best times in localStorage guarded; "Level 3 complete" in aria-live.
7. test.mjs: every cell reachable, w x h minus 1 passages, symmetric walls, solve finds the exit.
Quality bar:
- Walls never blur.
- Moves blocked by walls feel instant, no sliding through.
- Large mazes still fit the screen.
Pitfalls:
- Recursive generation overflowing the stack.
- Wall removed on one side only.
- Arrow keys scrolling the page.
Verify:
- [ ] Generator tested.
- [ ] Status live.
- [ ] Buttons typed.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, game.js, logic.mjs (generate, solve), test.mjs.

examples.input: a maze game that gets bigger each level
examples.output: seeded mazes 8x8 to 30x30, arrows/swipe, Hint shows 5 steps
